name: hyper_7dct
source: Game-owned 7-speed wet dual-clutch transaxle for the hypercar (automatic gearbox swap, 2026-10-16), NOT a specific gearbox [AS]. Ratios and efficiencies are physics_sim's hyper_7mt (data/gearboxes/hyper_7mt.json: 3.10-0.72, eta 0.97) so a swap keeps the car's gearing; odd gears on one input shaft and clutch, even gears and reverse on the other. Shift clutches 1900 N*m kinetic input-referred each, about 1.37 x the hyper V8's 1387 N*m peak (catalogue rating 1600 N*m) [AS]; handover (torque phase) 0.05 s, inertia-phase bound 0.25 s, preselect 0.10 s, engage 0.20 s [AS] (racing DCTs shift in tens of ms). Input inertia 0.03 kg*m^2 (two clutch packs), output 0.015 as hyper_7mt [AS].
